about: Operator checklist for the Zoho One afternoon: every step to set up the trial org, its fields, picklists, roles, Desk, Campaigns and Bookings, then import the seed exports in order (PLAN_admin_seed_v01.md section 13). Checking an item off writes to board_entries so the team sees progress live. Every person in these files is synthetic; nothing is ever sent.

steps.title: Org
steps.intro: The Zoho One trial everything else in this checklist is built on.

items.text: Create the Zoho One trial under hey@yeslifers.com, India datacentre (zoho.in).
to be verified: whether the Zoho One trial needs a card
to be verified: whether trial orgs cap record counts below the seed's totals
to be verified: whether Created Time can be mapped on CSV import; if not, the key-date fields carry the timeline and the audit stamp reads the import day
If HoA has already bought Zoho One, a second org is the sandbox; the live org is never used.

steps.title: Import order
steps.intro: Import in this order. Each external ID column makes a re-import update instead of duplicate. The files arrive via Drive; the board links none.
steps.generated: each item's file path, external ID column and row counts for run-500 and run-3000 are read from seed/export_schema.json and the export CSVs; no file is copied or linked (the files arrive via Drive; nothing seed-related is published except the masked admin bundle). One further item per campaigns/<stage>.csv is appended after Desk tickets, one per stage file found under the export directories (the schema carries one shared entry for all of them), id import/campaigns-<stage>.
